[ [Recantos que parecem saídos de um conto. Entre ribeiras, jardins naturais e paisagens
verdejantes, os Açores escondem lugares onde o tempo abranda e a natureza assume o protagonismo.
Aqui, cada detalhe convida a parar… e simplesmente apreciar. Hidden gems that seem straight out of a
fairy tale. Among streams, natural gardens, and verdant landscapes, the Azores hide places where
time slows down and nature takes center stage. Here, every detail invites you to stop… and simply
appreciate.] ][38]
[ [Nos Açores, cada trilho leva a uma nova descoberta. Entre florestas verdes, crateras vulcânicas e
paisagens únicas, caminhar pelas ilhas é mergulhar na natureza em estado puro. E no Faial, há sempre
mais um caminho por explorar. In the Azores, every trail leads to a new discovery. Among green
forests, volcanic craters, and unique landscapes, hiking through the islands is to immerse yourself
in nature in its purest form. And in Faial, there's always another path to explore. #visitazores
#açores #azores] ][39]
[ [Um dos postais mais icónicos dos Açores. ❤️🌊 Na Urzelina, a força do vulcão, o azul do Atlântico
e o emblemático moinho vermelho criam uma paisagem impossível de esquecer. Em São Jorge, cada pôr do
sol traz uma nova forma de admirar a natureza. One of the most iconic postcards of the Azores. ❤️🌊
In Urzelina, the force of the volcano, the blue of the Atlantic, and the emblematic red windmill
create an unforgettable landscape. In São Jorge, each sunset brings a new way to admire nature.
#visitazores #açores #azores] ][40]

o Atlântico. The Azores seen from a different perspective. Flying over volcanic craters, lagoons,
and endless green landscapes is to experience the true scale of Azorean nature. Here, the adventure

# Pura Vida

## Bienvenido a Costa Rica

Costa Rica is the land of pura vida. Take the quiz to discover your traveler type—and where your
journey begins.

[ Start your journey ][44]

## About Costa Rica

### An adventure, a retreat, an experience

Whether you’re seeking an adrenaline rush or deep relaxation – or a little of both – Costa Rica is
your ideal destination. We reserve more than a quarter of our land for conservation, meaning
undisturbed natural beauty is yours to enjoy. Top attractions with many activities call to visitors
from across the globe. Then in vibrant cities you’ll find fascinating art, history and
entertainment. We even have an official “Blue Zone” in the Nicoya Peninsula, meaning we have a high
number of centenarians thanks to our balanced diet, active lifestyle, strong social bonds and
integrated health care practices.

[Snorkeling adventure caribbean]
Costa Rica regions

## Caribbean


An enchanting combination of nature reserves and Afro Caribbean culture, the Caribbean region of
Costa Rica is known for sport fishing, birdwatching and exploring coral reefs.

[ explore the region ][45]

[A bird's eye view of a beach and a body of water]
Costa Rica regions

## Central Pacific


Hiking, cycling, horseback riding and sport fishing are just a few of the activities the Central
Pacific region offers. Curious visitors can also explore rural tourism opportunities.

[ explore the region ][46]

[Coffee beans]
Costa Rica Regions

## Central Valley


Home to our capital city, the Central Valley boasts fascinating museums, riveting theater and
delicious food. Outside of the city you’ll find indigenous sites and natural wonders.

[ explore the region ][47]

[An aerial view of a beach and a body of water]
Costa Rica Regions

## Guanacaste


Guanacaste is known as the cradle of our folklore and is home to beautiful landscapes ranging from
tropical dry forests and pristine beaches to lowland mountain forests.

[ explore the region ][48]

[Arenal volcano]
Costa Rica regions

## Northern Plains


Arenal Volcano towers over protected forests and heats natural hot springs. Rivers and waterfalls
flow through landscapes that look like fairy-tale settings.

[ explore the region ][49]

[Puntarenas Lighthouse]
Costa Rica regions

## Puntarenas


Puntarenas is one of the most popular tourism regions, loved for its coastline dotted with inlets
and islands. Explore the jungle and spot wildlife in the Monteverde Cloud Forest Biological
Preserve.

[ explore the region ][50]

[A woman riding a surfboard on top of a wave in the ocean]
Costa Rica regions

## South Pacific


The South Pacific area of Costa Rica is one of the most untouched regions and is covered in lush
rainforests and fringed by stunning beaches.

## Visit the Monteverde Cloud Forest Biological Reserve

If you like cool climates, views filled with green and hikes, this could be the destination you’ve
been looking for. The term “cloud forest” is no exaggeration, as you’ll be walking through trees in
the midst of a dense fog, produced at 1,600 meters above sea level.

[ read more ][82]

[Costa-Rica-hike-forest.png]

## 11 facts about Costa Rica that will surprise you

When it comes to Costa Rica, you’ve probably heard about “pura vida.” You probably know the
country’s biodiversity is off the charts, and maybe you even know that they got rid of their army
long ago. But beyond this basic info, what do you really know about the land of the ticos?

From local Costa Rican cuisine to artisan crafts to traditional customs and celebrations,

# Pura Vida

## Bienvenido a Costa Rica

Costa Rica is the land of pura vida. Take the quiz to discover your traveler type—and where your
journey begins.

[ Start your journey ][44]

## About Costa Rica

### An adventure, a retreat, an experience

Whether you’re seeking an adrenaline rush or deep relaxation – or a little of both – Costa Rica is
your ideal destination. We reserve more than a quarter of our land for conservation, meaning
undisturbed natural beauty is yours to enjoy. Top attractions with many activities call to visitors
from across the globe. Then in vibrant cities you’ll find fascinating art, history and
entertainment. We even have an official “Blue Zone” in the Nicoya Peninsula, meaning we have a high
number of centenarians thanks to our balanced diet, active lifestyle, strong social bonds and
integrated health care practices.

[Snorkeling adventure caribbean]
Costa Rica regions

## Caribbean


An enchanting combination of nature reserves and Afro Caribbean culture, the Caribbean region of
Costa Rica is known for sport fishing, birdwatching and exploring coral reefs.

[ explore the region ][45]

[A bird's eye view of a beach and a body of water]
Costa Rica regions

## Central Pacific


Hiking, cycling, horseback riding and sport fishing are just a few of the activities the Central
Pacific region offers. Curious visitors can also explore rural tourism opportunities.

[ explore the region ][46]

[Coffee beans]
Costa Rica Regions

## Central Valley


Home to our capital city, the Central Valley boasts fascinating museums, riveting theater and
delicious food. Outside of the city you’ll find indigenous sites and natural wonders.

[ explore the region ][47]

[An aerial view of a beach and a body of water]
Costa Rica Regions

## Guanacaste


Guanacaste is known as the cradle of our folklore and is home to beautiful landscapes ranging from
tropical dry forests and pristine beaches to lowland mountain forests.

[ explore the region ][48]

[Arenal volcano]
Costa Rica regions

## Northern Plains


Arenal Volcano towers over protected forests and heats natural hot springs. Rivers and waterfalls
flow through landscapes that look like fairy-tale settings.

[ explore the region ][49]

[Puntarenas Lighthouse]
Costa Rica regions

## Puntarenas


Puntarenas is one of the most popular tourism regions, loved for its coastline dotted with inlets
and islands. Explore the jungle and spot wildlife in the Monteverde Cloud Forest Biological
Preserve.

The South Pacific area of Costa Rica is one of the most untouched regions and is covered in lush
rainforests and fringed by stunning beaches.

A global leader in sustainability, Costa Rica pioneers eco-friendly practices for travel and other
industries – both within the region and around the world.

## Visit the Monteverde Cloud Forest Biological Reserve

If you like cool climates, views filled with green and hikes, this could be the destination you’ve
been looking for. The term “cloud forest” is no exaggeration, as you’ll be walking through trees in
the midst of a dense fog, produced at 1,600 meters above sea level.

[ read more ][82]

[Costa-Rica-hike-forest.png]
pura vida pura vida pura vida pura vida pura vida pura vida

## 11 facts about Costa Rica that will surprise you

When it comes to Costa Rica, you’ve probably heard about “pura vida.” You probably know the
country’s biodiversity is off the charts, and maybe you even know that they got rid of their army
long ago. But beyond this basic info, what do you really know about the land of the ticos?
